target.name: get_enricher
target.content: def get_enricher(         self, name: str, sketch_id: str, scan_id: str, **kwargs     ) -> Enricher:         if name not in self._enrichers:             raise Exception(f"Enricher '{name}' not found")         return self._enrichers[name](sketch_id=sketch_id, scan_id=scan_id, **kwargs)
